newsitem.title: USA: Home Properties to buy apartment community.
newsitem.headline: Home Properties to buy apartment community.

text.p: ROCHESTER, N.Y. Nov 25 (Reuter) Home Properties, a real estate investment trust specializing in apartment communities in the U.S. Northeast, said it had acquired an apartment community affiliated to Equity Residential.

The trust said it had paid $18.8 million in cash plus the assumption of $9.65 million of mortgage that bears interest at 8.5 percent for Valley Park South, a 384-unit community in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania.
During the past 12 months, Valley Park South generated net operating income of about $1.9 million.
Home Properties is a self-managed real estate investment trust which owns and manages 28 communities with 7,175 apartment units and one community containing 202 manufactured home sites.
